invalid.title: Invalid link
invalid.description: The link has expired or is no longer valid. Contact the marina for a new link.

bank.title: Bank transfer
bank.hint: Use the payment reference in the transfer: the marina will match the payment to the charges.

verifying.title: Payment being verified
verifying.description: We are waiting for the payment provider's confirmation. You can close this page: you will receive the receipt by email.

paid.title: Payment received
paid.description: Thank you, the payment has been recorded.

cancelled.title: Request cancelled
cancelled.description: This payment request was cancelled by the marina.

expired.title: Request expired
expired.description: Contact the marina for a new payment request.
